jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.location: New York, NY · Hybrid (up to 3 days/week in West Village)
jobs.why: Excellent overlap with healthcare operations, project management, cross-functional execution, process improvement, implementation work and stakeholder coordination. Your healthcare/ABA operations plus systems-project background gives you a strong, coherent story.
jobs.gap: Verana prefers consulting or healthcare data/analytics experience, and SQL Workbench is a nice-to-have. Present SQL only as foundational/working knowledge and emphasize project delivery and healthcare operations.

jobs.title: Operations Manager, Patient Experience
jobs.location: United States · Remote with regular customer-site work
jobs.why: Strong healthcare-tech match combining patient experience, product launches, implementation, customer operations, workflow building, stakeholder management and internal process improvement. Your healthcare operations and systems implementation experience map well.
jobs.gap: The role wants 3–4 years in SaaS/GTM/Product/Customer Success operations and comfort prototyping with AI tools. Frame your cross-functional systems work clearly without overstating SaaS product ownership.

jobs.title: Manager, Growth Operations
jobs.why: Healthcare growth role centered on process ownership, pipeline reporting, cross-functional coordination, site launches, playbooks and operational scaling. It fits your healthcare background while using your project-management and process-improvement strengths.
jobs.gap: Clinical-trial and life-sciences experience is preferred, so the main challenge is domain specificity rather than the core operating work.

jobs.title: Client Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong match for client operations, cross-functional execution, SOPs, KPI reporting, team support, stakeholder communication, onboarding and process improvement. The role also aligns with your interest in operations work that is broader than SEO.
jobs.gap: Playbook prefers 3+ years directly managing full-time employees plus hands-on budget and P&L experience, and the role supports commercial real-estate clients. Those are the biggest gaps to address carefully.

jobs.title: Systems Operations Manager
jobs.why: Strong fit for Salesforce administration, workflow automation, CRM data quality, dashboards, reporting, process documentation and user training — all close to your business-systems and Power Apps/Salesforce experience.
jobs.gap: Commure asks for strong Salesforce administration and Salesforce CPQ plus ZoomInfo/Outreach experience. Those platform-specific requirements are the biggest risk; SQL is only a nice-to-have and should be described as foundational/working knowledge.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.why: Good match for cross-functional initiatives, process improvement, customer/onboarding funnel work, structured problem-solving and using data to improve business performance at a growth-stage company.
jobs.gap: This role leans heavily toward management-consulting style analytics, financial/strategic modeling and executive-level problem solving, making it a reach relative to your strongest healthcare and systems matches.
